lanes.summary: The diff does what PMAT-4641 asks, and I found nothing that refutes it; four minor findings are below. The release path's CB-200 check no longer trusts the stored `[tdg] baseline`. Both Warn and Fail now go to scripts/check_cb200_head_vs_base.sh. That script measures head and the newest final tag that does not contain HEAD, with one pmat in one run and the stored baseline set to 0 in both trees. Every case where nothing was measured returns rc 3, and dogfood marks that FAIL. The gate only got stricter where it matters: Warn used to pass on the stored number alone and now also needs head ≤ base. Fail can become PASS only when head ≤ the last release, which is what the cop ruled. PMAT_BIN is exported by verifier_pin_pmat, so the helper runs with the pinned pmat. WORKLOG is a mktemp directory outside the repo, so the dirty-tree check is not polluted by dogfood's own files. I read the four refactors against the diff and they behave the same as before: in check_valid_under, both early `return`s stay in the parent before the two new helpers are called; get_one_patchid keeps the `\ ` / commit / From precedence and the fall-through order; the coverage_serve_shards solo check is vacuous when there is no solo file; nightly_manifest dispatches through the same argparse. I did not re-run anything; the recorded evidence is 17/17 cargo tests, byte-identical golden diffs and a 14/14 selftest. Tree witness: I could not produce it. /home/noah/src/aprender/.git/worktrees/0d-cb200/paiml-lane-witness does not exist (Read and Glob both found nothing), so I left tree_witness empty rather than make one up.

findings.claim: The receipt contradicts itself and the diff. Change item 2 says the check runs 'on CB-200 `Fail`' and that 'Pass/Warn unchanged', but the dogfood arm is `Warn|Fail)`, so Warn now changes too (the Round-4 section of the same receipt admits this).
findings.fix: Update Change item 2 to say Warn and Fail are both re-judged head-vs-release, and only Pass is unchanged.

findings.claim: The comment above the case block still says `Warn` 'is a GO — holding debt flat is the entire point'. Warn no longer passes on the stored baseline alone, so the comment is stale.
findings.fix: Reword lines 1197-1200 to say Warn is re-judged head-vs-release in the `Warn|Fail)` arm.

findings.claim: When there is no base ref, the message says 'CB-200 = Fail against the stored baseline' even when CM_CB200 is Warn, so the receipt text can misstate what pmat reported.
findings.fix: Put $CM_CB200 in the message instead of the literal 'Fail'.

findings.claim: The dirty-tree refusal runs only after the helper has run. On a dirty tree the result is still FAIL (it fails closed), but it can first spend up to four 900 s pmat runs measuring before throwing the result away.
